intro: This game teaches real space survival trade-offs using real NASA open data. Here is every dataset we use, what it does in the game, and whether it is archived or live.
nonEndorsement: This is an independent project made for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by NASA. All NASA data is used under its open-data policies.
officialForecastNote: DONKI is a NASA research/archival catalog, not an official forecast. The U.S. government's official source for space weather forecasts is the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. The 'forecast' in this game is a simplified game mechanic, not a real prediction.
